نستحثث (form X)
# نَسْتَحْثِثْ (nastaḥṯiṯ) /nas.taħ.θiθ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
# نُسْتَحْثَثْ (nustaḥṯaṯ) /nus.taħ.θaθ/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَحَثَّ (istaḥaṯṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
